attchmntText: The Indian Hotels Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: The Indian Hotels Company Limited has intimated the schedule for investor meetings under SEBI Listing Regulations. An in-person meeting is scheduled for November 18, 2026, at 09:00 am SGT. The event is Morgan Stanley's Twenty-Fifth Annual Asia Pacific Summit. The meeting format includes both one-on-one and group interactions. The notice was issued by Melisa Alva, Senior Vice President and Company Secretary, on November 12, 2026. The company scrip code is 500850 on BSE and the symbol is INDHOTEL on NSE.
